h1: Custom Drupal modules for features you cannot download
overview: If a contributed module almost does what you need, or nothing does, we write one for you. We build custom Drupal modules for things like a special content block, a member only area, an import from a spreadsheet or a connection to another system. We follow Drupal coding standards, test on a staging copy, and hand over the code with a plain explanation so any Drupal developer can maintain it.

faq: Should I use an existing module instead?
Often yes, and we will say so. Before building, we check for a maintained contributed module that fits. If one does, we can configure it for far less than custom code.
Will the module survive Drupal updates?
We write to current Drupal standards, which helps. Major version changes can need small updates later, and we note any parts likely to be affected in the documentation.
You do. We hand over the module code and notes, and you can host it in your own repository and hire any developer to extend it.
What do you need to get started?
A staging copy of your site, a clear description of the feature, and examples of how editors or visitors should use it. A short call helps us avoid guessing.
